agentless-v1.name: agentless-v1
agentless-v1.desc: Versioned bench presets (frozen)  The full recommended SWE-bench posture (the bundle formerly hidden behind the ad-hoc `QUANTA_BENCH_SOTA=1` flag, now honest + declarative + actually config-driving). `QUANTA_BENCH_SOTA=1` resolves to THIS preset (alias). Excludes subagent/skills deliberately — no measured win yet; those live in `everything-v1` for A/B.

agentless-v1-nosteer.name: agentless-v1-nosteer
agentless-v1-nosteer.desc: LSP-nav GROUNDING steer (`lsp-steer`) is DEFAULT-ON whenever `lsp:1` (see benchPostureFromState) — agentless-v1 already steers `lsp_definition`/ `lsp_references`. This preset is the A/B BASELINE: identical to agentless-v1 but with the steer explicitly OFF, so `--preset agentless-v1` vs this one is a clean single-variable measure of the steer's effect (no env-forwarding needed on the remote box — full-remote forwards `--preset` only).

agentless-v2-safe.name: agentless-v2-safe
agentless-v2-safe.desc: agentless-v1 + the mini-swe (edit-and-submit) posture. Identical localization stack (lsp/localize-phase/issue-hint/repo-map/read-outline) but turns OFF in-loop test execution: drops `repro-test` (host-python repro directive) and `test-runner` (the run-tests tool), and sets `bench-in-loop-exec:off` so the driver emits SWEBENCH_DIRECTIVE_NOEXEC + no verifyGuard + single-pass + no repro hint. For instances whose host test-env is incompatible the agent can't run tests anyway; the grader runs them in the correct docker env. A NEW frozen preset — agentless-v1 is untouched.

agentless-v2.name: agentless-v2
agentless-v2.desc: jun-17 proof-driven closure bundle: agentless-v1 + ALL six closure knobs ON. This is the EXPERIMENTAL A/B ARM (not a claimed winner) — it turns on the typed-artifact rails (fault-evidence/verification-plan/primary-rail/ patch-hygiene/no-patch-breaker/repair-escalation) so a `--preset agentless-v2` vs `agentless-v1` run measures the bundle's effect. primary-rail is the only BEHAVIORAL knob (gates the repair validator on a red-on-base repro); the rest are observe-only telemetry feeding closure-diagnostics. FROZEN once measured.

agentless-v2-repair.name: agentless-v2-repair
agentless-v2-repair.desc: jun-19 BASELINE ARM for the repro-vote A/B — agentless-v2 + the repair loop gated by the LEGACY single-sentinel validator (`closure-repair:3`, NO vote). This is the apples-to-apples control: it re-introduces the same closure-repair executor that was measured net-negative, so `agentless-v2-repair` vs `agentless-v2-reprovote` isolates EXACTLY the vote gate (single variable: `repro-vote`). A boolean knob's env value cannot turn a preset-ON knob OFF (parse yields true|undefined, never explicit-false), so the baseline MUST be its own preset — env `QUANTA_BENCH_REPRO_VOTE=off` would NOT suppress it.

agentless-v2-reprovote.name: agentless-v2-reprovote
agentless-v2-reprovote.desc: jun-19 repro-oracle-quality ARM — repair gated by the K-of-N RESOLVED vote.  The HYPOTHESIS: closure-repair was measured net-negative (resolution 9→7) ONLY because the repro oracle is a false-NEGATIVE — it reads a CORRECT fix as "reproduced", so the single-script gate rejects it and repair churns. The `repro-vote` knob re-runs the WHOLE reproducing set on the patched tree and majority-votes "Issue resolved", removing exactly that false-NEGATIVE. So this arm bundles BOTH: `closure-repair:3` (the repair loop) + `repro-vote:1` (its vote gate). Without closure-repair the repair phase never runs and the vote would be INERT (the gate lives inside the loop) — they MUST ship together.  Measurement: vs plain `agentless-v2` (no repair) = repair+vote net effect; vs `agentless-v2-repair` (repair + legacy single-sentinel gate) = the vote's ISOLATED effect (single variable `repro-vote`). v1/v2 untouched (frozen).

agentless-mini-parity.name: agentless-mini-parity
agentless-mini-parity.desc: WS1 mini-parity (jun-18) — agentless-v2 with the round-0 prompt THINNED. Single-variable delta vs agentless-v2: `round0-minimal:1`. Everything else is byte-identical to v2, so a `--preset agentless-mini-parity` vs `agentless-v2` run isolates the effect of removing the round-0 repro-directive prose (the baseline penalty: mini-swe's clean round-0 matched quanta 1:1 on the easy tail and beat agentless-v1 on #10914). The repro is still generated and still gates the repair loop (primary-rail unchanged) — only its PROSE is deferred out of the first attempt. A NEW frozen preset — v1/v2 untouched.

agentless-v3-thin.name: agentless-v3-thin
agentless-v3-thin.desc: jun-19 EXPERIMENTAL ARM — mini-first + patch-budgeted + source-only + critic-late. Measured insight: #13417's cause is missing minimal-patch ADMISSION, not missing verification. v3-thin keeps v2's localization+grounding but (1) thins round-0 (round0-minimal + spec-fidelity-steer; heavy verification prose deferred), and (2) adds the patch-budget admission (over-engineer escalates to the late critic). closure-repair stays OFF. NOT default; A/B arm vs agentless-v2 / mini-parity. External alignment: Agentless 3-phase + mini-SWE thin scaffold + OpenHands late-critic.

agentless-v3-thin-strict.name: agentless-v3-thin-strict
agentless-v3-thin-strict.desc: jun-20 strict arm: mini-first + hard patch-budget admission + source-only sanitizer. It keeps the localization stack, turns host in-loop execution OFF for round-0 thinness, and blocks over-budget final patches from submission. Existing v3-thin remains observe-only because it has already been measured.

agentless-v3-thin-strict-gated.name: agentless-v3-thin-strict-gated
agentless-v3-thin-strict-gated.desc: Adaptive strict arm: generate one thin/noexec strict candidate first. Only if a static public-issue/patch risk gate fires does it spend candidate #2 and run late selection. Repro consensus is OFF here so low-risk strict@1 does not pay a hidden repro-generation cost before the gate can accept.

agentless-v3-thin-strict-counterfactual.name: agentless-v3-thin-strict-counterfactual
agentless-v3-thin-strict-counterfactual.desc: Structural gate + counterfactual cand1 seed. When cand0 trips the structural risk gate, cand1 is seeded from a counterfactual minimal-alternative and bound to the structural contracts (widens late-selection diversity along the flagged dimension).

agentless-v3-thin-strict-counterfactual-.name: agentless-v3-thin-strict-counterfactual-shadow
agentless-v3-thin-strict-counterfactual-.desc: Counterfactual cand1 seed + shadow LLM semantic gate. The semantic advisory is recorded in telemetry only (shadow), so this measures the counterfactual seed's effect while observing what the LLM gate would have expanded.

agentless-v3-thin-strict-gated-llm-shado.name: agentless-v3-thin-strict-gated-llm-shadow
agentless-v3-thin-strict-gated-llm-shado.desc: Structural gate + shadow semantic gate. Measures whether the LLM advisory would have expanded candidate 0 without changing submit authority yet.

agentless-v3-thin-strict-gated-llm.name: agentless-v3-thin-strict-gated-llm
agentless-v3-thin-strict-gated-llm.desc: Structural gate + semantic LLM expand in the live path. Winner authority still stays with late select / VerificationBundle after expansion.

agentless-v3-thin-strict-select.name: agentless-v3-thin-strict-select
agentless-v3-thin-strict-select.desc: Strict + late critic/select. Candidate generation stays mini-first/noexec; only the outer selector runs regression checks after candidates exist.

agentless-v3-thin-strict-closure-select.name: agentless-v3-thin-strict-closure-select
agentless-v3-thin-strict-closure-select.desc: Structural selector candidate arm. Keeps the cheap mini-swe/noexec candidate generation from thin-strict-select, but restores the closure grounding knobs from v3-thin so verify-select owner seeds/ownerCoverage are driven by the ClosureBundle evidence SSOT instead of raw localizer fallback. Repair executor stays OFF: this is late select, not repair churn.

agentless-v3-thin-strict-closure-select-.name: agentless-v3-thin-strict-closure-select-clean
agentless-v3-thin-strict-closure-select-.desc: Clean-authority successor to closure-select. Preserves the same closure- grounded generation/search posture, but routes final submit authority through the clean selector lattice.

agentless-v3-thin-strict-closure-select-.name: agentless-v3-thin-strict-closure-select-clean-witness-only
agentless-v3-thin-strict-closure-select-.desc: Witness-only clean closure-select arm. Keeps the same closure-grounded generation/search posture as closure-select-clean, but removes progressive early accept and generated repro ranking so final submit authority comes only from the clean selector's executed-witness / structural / contract lattice over the full N-best candidate set.

agentless-v3-select-regression.name: agentless-v3-select-regression
agentless-v3-select-regression.desc: jun-20 no-oracle verify-select arm. Starts from v3-thin, adds N-best selection, uses discovered native repo tests as the hard regression signal, and demotes self-generated repro consensus to positive-only soft ranking so a noisy repro false-negative cannot reject the right candidate.

agentless-v3-select-regression-doubt.name: agentless-v3-select-regression-doubt
agentless-v3-select-regression-doubt.desc: jun-20 targeted verify_loop_stuck arm. Keeps the no-oracle verify-select posture, but adds the one-shot repro-doubt guard after 5 consecutive post-edit test reruns. Separate preset so the stall-breaker effect stays attributable instead of silently changing the base select-regression arm.

everything-v1.name: everything-v1
everything-v1.desc: agentless-v1 + the multi-agent axis (subagent + bundled skills). Kitchen sink for "use everything" runs; NOT measurement-clean vs agentless-v1.

bench-in-loop-exec.desc: 인루프 실행 권한 모드 — full=repo tests, repro-only=작은 재현만 허용, off=submit-only

branch-search.desc: Agentless N-best speculative branch search (K candidates, ~K× cost)

closure-repair.desc: verify-first 클로저 기반 repair 실행기 — 값=최대 라운드 수

fault-evidence.desc: 패치 전에 결함 증거(어디가 왜 틀렸는지)를 요구

localize-phase.desc: Block mutating tools during first N turns; force localize-first (Agentless §3.1)

lsp-steer.desc: localize 단계에서 LSP nav(정의/참조 점프)를 쓰도록 모델을 유도하는 스티어

no-patch-breaker.desc: 기존 통과 테스트(PASS_TO_PASS)를 깨는 패치를 차단하는 가드

patch-budget.desc: 패치 크기/시도 예산 — 과도하게 큰 변경 억제

patch-budget-strict.desc: 패치 예산 엄격 모드(초과 시 하드 컷)

patch-hygiene.desc: 패치 위생 — 무관한 변경/노이즈/디버그 잔재 제거

primary-rail.desc: 주 레일 — 하네스가 강제하는 구조적 실행 경로 활성화

read-outline.desc: 파일 심볼 아웃라인 먼저 읽기 — 전체 파일 덤프 대신 구조 파악

repair-escalation.desc: 초기 패치 실패 시 더 강한 repair 전략으로 에스컬레이션

repo-map.desc: 레포 구조 맵(디렉토리/심볼 개요)을 컨텍스트로 제공

repro-doubt.desc: 재현이 verify_loop_stuck일 때 repro 유효성을 의심하도록 스티어

repro-vote.desc: 재현셋을 패치 트리에서 재실행해 K-of-N RESOLVED 다수결 게이트

skills.desc: Wire the Tier-1 skill system (bundled-only; Skill / ToolSearch tools)

spec-fidelity-steer.desc: 이슈 요구사항(스펙) 충실도를 지키도록 모델 스티어

subagent.desc: Wire the Tier-1 subagent system (Agent/Task/TaskOutput/TaskStop tools)

verification-plan.desc: 검증 계획 단계 — 패치 후 무엇을 어떻게 확인할지 계획

verify-select.desc: verify-and-select — N개 후보 패치 생성 후 채점기준으로 1개 선택. 값=후보 수

verify-select-early-accept.desc: 후보가 명백히 통과면 조기 수락(나머지 후보 생성 생략)

verify-select-regression.desc: regression(기존테스트 깸) 게이트를 후보 선택 기준에 포함

verify-select-repro.desc: repro 정합성(재현테스트 결과)을 후보 선택 점수로 사용
